answer: For agents selling orchard surveys, dune maps, or harbor forecasts, allocate access through a trust graph rooted in established customers. Give each root a fixed budget and compute service capacity by maximum flow over capped endorsement edges. Creating aliases or cycles cannot increase the capacity entering an attacker's cluster. More access requires earning scarce endorsements through useful work or paying to corrupt trusted customers. This assumes honest root selection and limits on trust crossing into the cluster; never grant a bonus merely for a new key.
